map.弹性势能 U = ½ × k × x²，k 为弹簧劲度系数（N/m）、x 为形变: Elastic potential energy U = ½ × k × x², where k is the spring stiffness (N/m) and x the deflection (m); spring force F = k × x; the energy grows with the square of the deflection, so doubling the deflection makes the energy four times larger (for example k = 200 N/m and x = 0.1 m give F = 20 N and U = 1 J).
